title: person identity matcher (per-class matchers, not just vehicles)
author: the operator
trigger: PIPELINE-SPEC-2026-09-10.md step 10 explicitly says 'Match against known entities (per-class matchers, not just vehicles)'. VM2 prompt for mode=person (line 16) asks Qwen-VL for 'identity markers' (clothing, height, etc). Today's implementation only matches mode=vehicle — listener/pipeline.py:177-180 has `if mode == 'vehicle': match_vehicle(...)`. People fire no match, no TG#3, and the cooldown records without a per-class match signal. Confirmed 2026-09-12 against the alert b2c43a12-... (camera=FRONT, mode=person, conf=0.88): pipeline reached vm2 then fell through to record_hit with no match attempted and no TG#3 dispatched. The spec/code gap has been open since 2026-09-10.
background: V2-032 is the mirror of V2-027 (vehicle match) for people. The vehicle matcher is a pure string match: license plate exact (case-insensitive, whitespace-stripped), then Jaccard on distinctive_features. PRD-V2-032 mirrors that pattern: 'identity_markers' exact-match on a key identifier (e.g. operator-defined 'tag' like 'red-jacket-beard'), then Jaccard on the full features list. The VM2 prompt for mode=person already returns 'identity_markers' as a list[str] of features; the matcher consumes that directly. No new model dependency (no InsightFace, no embeddings). Privacy follows the V2-018 convention: known_people.json lives in data/known/people/ and is gitignored; only the schema and an empty placeholder are in the repo. Same scope shape as V2-018 vehicle enrollment (US-018e).
shipping_definition: All US-032 stories marked done; pytest 270+ tests pass; tree clean; listener/pipeline.py stage 12 calls match_person() for mode='person'; telegram_formatter/match_alert.py renders match/no-match captions for both vehicle AND person; data/known/people/known_people.json schema documented; an empty placeholder file lives at the path; .gitignore excludes real enrollment data; integration test exercises the full person-alert path (gate -> vm2 -> match_person -> TG#3); git log shows one commit per story.
scope_exclusions: Face embedding models (InsightFace/ArcFace/dlib) are NOT this PRD. The matcher is text-on-VM2-output, mirroring match_vehicle. Embeddings are a future PRD if the operator asks.
Adding person identity to the camera_creds or auth layer is NOT this PRD.
Cooldown changes are NOT this PRD (record_hit already fires for any non-vehicle after VM2 today).
TG#2 / TG#1 caption changes are NOT this PRD (those are TG-format PRDs).
Animal matching is NOT this PRD -- data/known/animals/known_animals.json exists but no matcher. Animal match is a future PRD if asked.
Backfilling historical person alerts is NOT this PRD -- only new alerts going forward.
design_principles: Mirror match_vehicle: pure function, no I/O, no network. Inputs are vm2_result dict and candidates list; output is the matched candidate dict with 'matched': True, or {'matched': False}.
Per-class dispatch: listener/pipeline.py keeps one match stage that switches on mode. New mode 'person' branch calls match_person(). Existing vehicle branch unchanged.

VM2 contract for mode=person is locked: must include 'identity_markers' (list[str]). The current VM2 prompt already asks for it. The matcher reads identity_markers; absence yields {'matched': False} (no raise -- person alerts without markers should still produce TG#2, just no TG#3 match).

Match strategy: an exact-match 'tag' (first identity_marker) first (case-insensitive, whitespace-stripped), then Jaccard >= 0.5 on the full identity_markers set. Same shape as license-plate-first-then-Jaccard in match_vehicle.

Privacy-first storage: data/known/people/known_people.json follows the V2-018 convention. The repo contains an empty placeholder schema + a unit-test fixture. Real enrollments live outside version control.

TG#3 reuse: telegram_formatter/match_alert.py is the formatter for both vehicle and person match. The format string is already generic ('Match: <matched | no_match>'); pass the matched dict through and let the formatter render the name field. No new formatter module.
Test coverage: unit tests for match_person pure logic + integration test through pipeline.run() with a fake vm2_result and a real candidates list.
Card body budget: 2500 chars per story (kanban worker spec).

stories.title: add person_matcher/match.py with match_person() pure function
acceptance: person_matcher/__init__.py and person_matcher/match.py exist mirroring vehicle_matcher/.
match_person(vm2_result: dict, candidates: list[dict]) -> dict is importable from person_matcher.match.
Match strategy mirrors match_vehicle: 'tag' exact (case-insensitive, whitespace-stripped) first, then Jaccard >= 0.5 on identity_markers.
